data.title: Important Dates
data.author: Arpan
data.body:
Important Dates

January

  • 9th Jan - প্রবাসী ভারতীয় দিবস
  • 10 Jan - World Hindi Day
  • 12 Jan - National Youth Day
  • 15 Jan - Army Day
  • 23 Jan - Netaji Birth Anniversary
  • 24 Jan - National girl Child Day
  • 25 Jan - Indian Tourism Day / Voters Day
  • 26 Jan - Republic Day / International Customs Day
  • 30 Jan - শহীদ দিবস

February

  • 2nd Feb - বিশ্ব জলাভূমি দিবস
  • 4th Feb - World Cancer Day
  • 13th Feb - National Women's Day
  • 14th Feb - Valentine's Day
  • 20th Feb - World Social Justice Day
  • 21st Feb - ভাষা দিবস
  • 24th Feb - Central Excise Day
  • 28th Feb - National Science Day

March

  • 3rd Mar - World Wildlife Dayদিবস) (বিশ্ব বন্যজীব দিবস)
  • 4th Mar - National Security Day
  • 8th Mar - International Women's Day
  • 15th Mar - World Consumer Rights Day (বিশ্ব উপভোক্তা অধিকার দিবস)
  • 16th Mar - জাতীয় টীকাকরন দিবস
  • 21st Mar - World Disabled Day / বিশ্ব অরণ্য দিবস
  • 22nd Mar - World Water Conservation Day
  • 23rd Mar - RBS শহীদ দিবস / World Meteorological Day (বিশ্ব আবহাওয়া দিবস)
  • 24th Mar - World TB Day

April

  • 1 Apr - April Fool's Day
  • 7 Apr - World Health Day
  • 10 Apr - World Homeopathy Day
  • 13 Apr - Jalianwalabag Day
  • 14 Apr - Dr. BM Ambedkar Jayanti
  • 18 Apr - World Heritage Day
  • 21 Apr - Indian Civil Service Day
  • 22 Apr - Earth Day
  • 23 Apr - World Book and Copyright Day
  • 24 Apr - National Panchayati Raj Day
  • 25 Apr - Malaria Day

May

  • On the first Sunday of May - World Comedy Day
  • 1st May - May Day / World
  • 8th May - Red Cross Day
  • 11th May - National Technology Day
  • 12th May - International Nurse Day
  • 17th May - Commonwealth Day
  • 30th May - Hindi Journalism Day
  • 31st May - World No Tobacco Day

June

  • 5th Jun - বিশ্ব পরিবেশ দিবস
  • 12th Jun - বাল্য শ্রম নির্বন্ধ দিবস
  • 14th Jun - World Blood Donation Day
  • 20 Jun - World Refugee Day (শরণার্থী)
  • 21st Jun - Yoga Day
  • 23rd Jun - International Olympic Day
  • 29th Jun - National Statistics Day

July

  • 1st Jul - Doctor's Day
  • 11th Jul - World Population Day
  • 24th Jul - Income Tax Day
  • 26th Jul - কার্গিল বিজয় দিবস
  • 29th Jul - ব্যাঘ্র সংরক্ষণ দিবস
